bullets.text: Public staged a road blockade near Periyapalayam over a five-hour power outage, disrupting traffic on the Chennai-Tirupati road, and the office should monitor power supply stability.
PMK leader Anbumani urged Chief Minister Vijay to intervene in the Pallikaranai marshland issue, and the office should watch for potential policy announcements or protests.
Eighty-one people lost their eyesight from firecrackers during Deepavali in Thiruvallur, showing an increase from previous years, and the office should review safety measures.
Gummidipoondi fire and rescue personnel conducted an accident-free Deepavali awareness event at a government boys school, and the office should support local safety outreach programs.
ELCOT and IIT Madras Pravartak Technologies signed an agreement for an AI data center project monitoring unit for the Tamil Nadu government, and the office should track progress.
LiveX and NVIDIA launched AI City at the Smart City Expo in Barcelona to bring physical AI to airports and hospitals, and the office should note technological advancements.

stories.title: பெரியபாளையம் அருகே 5 மணிநேரம் மின்வெட்டு கண்டித்து சாலை மறியல்
takeaways: Public blocked the Chennai Tirupati highway near Periyapalayam for thirty minutes demanding restoration after prolonged power outages.
District officials must address persistent electricity disruptions in Thiruvallur to prevent further traffic blockades and public unrest.

stories.title: LiveX Brings Physical AI to Airports, Hospitals and Stores With the Launch of AI City
takeaways: LiveX and NVIDIA launched AI City at the Smart City Expo World Congress in Barcelona.
The new platform introduces physical artificial intelligence applications for airports, hospitals, and retail stores.
